event_properties.name: action
event_properties.description: Low-cardinality action label for extension and website interactions.

event_properties.name: activity_day_key
event_properties.description: Local activity day key in YYYY-MM-DD format for extension analytics.

event_properties.name: activity_week_key
event_properties.description: Local ISO-style activity week key for extension analytics.

event_properties.name: analytics_source
event_properties.description: Product surface that emitted the event, such as saturn_extension or the public website.

event_properties.name: analytics_schema_version
event_properties.description: Version of the extension analytics event contract.

event_properties.name: block_source
event_properties.description: Source of a block event: limit, scheduled, or unknown.

event_properties.name: block_tier
event_properties.description: Configured block strictness tier.

event_properties.name: capped_count
event_properties.description: Number of preset rules not created because the plan limit was reached.

event_properties.name: conflict_count
event_properties.description: Number of preset rules not created because an equivalent rule already existed.

event_properties.name: created_count
event_properties.description: Number of rules created by a preset application.

event_properties.name: cta_location
event_properties.description: Website CTA placement for conversion clicks.

event_properties.name: destination
event_properties.description: Normalized destination label for website clicks.

event_properties.name: error_name
event_properties.description: Low-cardinality error name for failed analytics or redirect events.

event_properties.name: extension_version
event_properties.description: Saturn extension version that emitted the event.

event_properties.name: extension_id
event_properties.description: Production extension identifier added by the trusted analytics Worker.

event_properties.name: is_first_activity_this_week
event_properties.description: 1 when this is the first extension analytics event observed this week for the install, otherwise 0.

event_properties.name: is_first_activity_today
event_properties.description: 1 when this is the first extension analytics event observed today for the install, otherwise 0.

event_properties.name: funnel_version
event_properties.description: Funnel instrumentation version sent with extension adoption events.

event_properties.name: has_block_history
event_properties.description: 1 when the anonymous install has recorded a prior local block, otherwise 0.

event_properties.name: has_limit
event_properties.description: 1 when the anonymous install currently has at least one site limit, otherwise 0.

event_properties.name: has_schedule
event_properties.description: 1 when the anonymous install currently has at least one scheduled block, otherwise 0.

event_properties.name: install_reason
event_properties.description: Chrome install/update reason for post-install redirect events.

event_properties.name: link_domain
event_properties.description: Destination domain for public website outbound and CTA clicks.

event_properties.name: link_text
event_properties.description: Visible link text for public website click events.

event_properties.name: link_url
event_properties.description: Destination URL for public website click events.

event_properties.name: onboarding_step
event_properties.description: Step index shown when an onboarding funnel event fires.

event_properties.name: onboarding_complete
event_properties.description: 1 when onboarding is complete for the anonymous install, otherwise 0.

event_properties.name: percent_scrolled
event_properties.description: Scroll-depth threshold reached on the website.

event_properties.name: preset_id
event_properties.description: Preset template identifier used by preset_applied events.

event_properties.name: rule_type
event_properties.description: Preset rule category used by preset_applied events.

event_properties.name: previous_activity_day_key
event_properties.description: Previous local activity day key seen before the current extension analytics event.

event_properties.name: section_id
event_properties.description: Website section identifier viewed or interacted with.

event_properties.name: section_label
event_properties.description: Readable website section label for section and FAQ events.

event_properties.name: screen_name
event_properties.description: Low-cardinality public website walkthrough screen label.

event_properties.name: skipped_count
event_properties.description: Total number of preset rules skipped because of conflicts or plan limits.

event_properties.name: trigger
event_properties.description: Low-cardinality trigger/source label for extension events.

intentionally_excluded.name: raw_extension_domain_or_url
intentionally_excluded.reason: Extension analytics deliberately avoids raw domains, raw URLs, redirect IDs, client IDs, emails, and notes. Website link_url is limited to public Saturn outbound CTA destinations.
